_comment: ORDER-602 A. Append-only sign-off log for the S2a proposal. THE OWNER WRITES HERE, and nothing else has to change: no edit to check_s2a_migration.py, no edit to gen_s2a_migration.py, no edit to s2a_migration.jsonl. That separation is the point -- while the decision lived inside the proposal, recording an approval meant editing the evidence, the acceptance rule and the generator in one commit, after which nothing could tell an owner approving from an author weakening the guard (Codex audit 7 MAJOR 2). Append one object per decision; never edit or delete a previous line. Required fields: proposal_sha256, current_owner, decision (APPROVED|REFUSED), signer, decided_at, reason. REFUSED additionally requires a non-empty reason. The latest line for a given current_owner wins, so a decision is changed by appending a new one, which leaves the earlier decision visible. Run `check_s2a_signoff.py` to see the exact proposal_sha256 to quote and a ready-made template line.
